<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>

The Ultra Space plugin
Allows you to restrict access to specific worlds and regions where players can only access them using a defined set.
You can create oxygen tanks, necessary for the different worlds.
These can be fully configured, defining how often oxygen will be taken.

----------------------------------------

PUNISHMENT MODES

There are several types of punishment for when you run out of oxygen or remove a part of your suit.
- DEATH 
- INSTANT DEATH
- SPAWN


The plugin is compatible with Itemsadder; you can use its ID to directly define which items go in each part of your suit.
You can configure the death effect, creating an explosion with sound and particles.

----------------------------------------

COMMANDS
- /ultraspace give <tank/oxygen/suit/jetpack/fuel> <player> <id>
- /ultraspace reload

For any questions, you can ask on our Discord server.
https://discord.gg/ZdhHrURycn
